instagram.body:
$440K MRR founder reveals the exact tech stack behind his 70K+ subscriber app

You’d expect some insane, cutting-edge, overengineered setup behind it.

But there isn’t.

No fancy buzzwords.
No “we rebuilt everything 3 times.”
No 25-engineer team.

Just a simple stack… used really well.

Even with AI tools, he’s disciplined.

He doesn’t let AI go rogue.
He’s extremely specific about what gets touched.

Reviews everything.
Stays in control.

That’s the part most people miss.

It’s not about using more tools.
It’s about using fewer… better.

$440K/month wasn’t built on hype.

It was built on restraint.

👇 Comment or DM me “MICROSAAS” and I’ll send you the full episode.
Last month we made over 440k. What's your tech stack? How did you build this app? We use React Native and Expo. For the back end, I did dot net for most of the core functionality. I've also used Next and React to build some like internal admin dashboards. In terms of AI, so I try to stay kind of niche with the what I use. Cursor a lot, but I'm very specific which files to touch and don't let the AI just go rogue, basically.
